title: Kanda–Nihonbashi current source building geometry
source_match_rule: Exact original gml_id joined to current asset_id; current GIS membership is unchanged.
selection_rule: Full original footprint covered by fixed registered official Figure 5 study outline; no clipping or enlargement.
gltf_axes: x=easting+5600; y=original CityGML orthometric elevation; z=-(northing+34320)
vertical_note: Original CityGML orthometric elevations are preserved. Ground terrain and textures are omitted. LOD2 means more roof and wall detail; no improvement in measured positional accuracy is claimed.
highest_available_check: PLATEAU delivery API maxlod4, lod3 and lod4 queried for both wards on 2026-10-20; maxlod4 resolves 2025 LOD2, lod3/lod4 empty. Actual _lod checked for every selected object.
display_use: Visual survey and geometry review. The mesh is not validated for CFD and must not be overlaid on old solver fields.
license: PLATEAU / Public Data License1.0 compatible with CC BY4.0; original municipality copyright retained
attribution: PLATEAU 3D City Model, Chiyoda and Chuo wards, 2025; Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism. Extracted, coordinates transformed, textures omitted for Urban Design Studio 2026.

quality.numerical_mesh_status: Source surface edge checks passed at 0.1mm weld tolerance. Self-intersections, ground contact and CFD solver suitability remain unchecked.
